'''Yukiri Haruna''' is an [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[Gray Ajah]] and a [[Sitter]] in the [[Hall of the Tower]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Yukiri Haruna|Yukiri}} During the [[White Tower Schism]], Yukiri voted to depose [[Siuan Sanche]] and replace her with [[Elaida do Avriny a'Roihan|Elaida a'Roihan]], although she soon came to regret the decision in light of Elaida's growing incompetence. 

Yukiri and a group of other Sitters formed the [[Black Ajah Hunters]] after Elaida grew deeply suspicious of [[Alviarin Freidhen]], and were able to independently confirm the existence of the [[Black Ajah]]. She eventually began to work with [[Egwene al'Vere]] when she was held in the White Tower and reduced to a [[novice]], and remains one of most senior sisters in the Tower.

== Appearance and Personality == 
Yukiri has green eyes and a small frame and is described as 5 feet tall, slight and slender. [[Egwene al'Vere]] thinks she is one of the shortest women she has ever met.{{ref/book|12|12}}

Despite her lack of height, she manages to comport herself as regally as any Queen. When frustrated, however, she can relapse into the farmer's accent of her youth. During negotiations and mediations she has been known to use her native accent as a way to unbalance the other parties as the contrast can leave them confused.

She is known for being incredibly stubborn and is often the last to join a consensus, both in the Hall and in discussions with sisters of her own Ajah.{{ref/book|10|21}}{{ref/book|7|26}}

== Strength and Abilities ==
Yukiri is [[Strength in the One Power among Aes Sedai|very strong]] in the [[One Power]] for an Aes Sedai, with a strength of {{opsl|20}}. Only four other women out the Tower loyalists we have details on can match her strength, and only Elaida exceeds it.{{ref|{{twotc}}}}{{ref|{{twotc}}, Yukiri Haruna}}

Despite her considerable strength, she is self-admittedly a slow learner; a barrier she has overcome with relentless study, as she struggled for everything she learned. This dedication to her craft allowed Yukiri to discover a particular talent with the [[travel]] weave, allowing her to develop a gateway that opens horizontally. This weave has proven useful for providing reconnaissance on enemy armies from above.

== History ==
Yukiri was born in {{ne|837}} to an innkeeper in [[Gorien Springs]], a village south of [[Arafel]] on the road from [[Shol Arbela]] to [[Tar Valon]]. 

She went to the Tower in {{ne|852}}. After spending eight years as [[Novice]] and seven as [[Accepted]] she was raised to the shawl in the year {{ne|867}}. She was elected Sitter some years before the [[schism]].

She has not [[Bonding|bonded]] another [[Warder]] since hers died about a dozen years ago.

== Activities ==

She remained loyal to the [[White Tower]] during the [[Schism]] {{ref/book|12|12}} and indeed was one of the Sitters who were persuaded/manipulated to vote for the deposition of [[Siuan Sanche]] and raise [[Elaida]] as the new [[Amyrlin Seat]]. She and the other Sitters soon regretted this decision. Yukiri in particular was given a Penance of Labor by Elaida and set to scrubbing floors like a novice, which would only have served to sharpen the animosity felt.

=== Hunting the Black Ajah ===

Yukiri notices Seaine and Pevara spending a lot of time together. Alongside [[Doesine Alwain]], [[Saerin Asnobar]], and [[Talene Minly]], she follows [[Pevara Tazanovni]] and [[Seaine Herimon]] into one of the basement rooms below the White Tower, where the latter two are discovered with the [[Oath Rod]]{{ref/book|8|26}}.

Yukiri reswears her [[Three Oaths]], proving she is not [[Black Ajah]], but Talene refuses to reswear them and is discovered to be Black Ajah. Talene is questioned on the [[Chair of Remorse]] in order to drag this confession from her{{ref/book|9|p}}. Through Seaine and Pevara, Yukiri finds out about the [[Salidar]] spies in the Tower, including two sisters from her own Ajah, [[Meidani Eschede]] and [[Jennet Cobb]].

Using knowledge of this perceived treachery, she forces Meidani to renew her [[pillow friends|friendship]] with [[Elaida do Avriny a'Roihan]] in order to gain evidence on whether Elaida is Black Ajah.

Yukiri is present when Elaida grants the Sitters' requests to begin negotiations with the [[rebel Aes Sedai]].

Yukiri spends time walking through the Tower with Meidani, one of the Gray rebels. They speak about several things, including Elaida. They run into [[Bernaile Gelbarn]] and Seaine. Seaine and Yukiri go off to speak about the mystery involving the new Sitters in the Hall{{ref/book|10|p}}.

[[Marris Thornhill]] breaks under questioning and confesses to being Black Ajah. Yukiri makes her take the oath of obedience as well. Yukiri meets with Pevara in the halls to tell her about Marris. The two of them pretend to be studying wall hangings as they talk. Yukiri also tells Pevara about the summons that Talene has received to appear before the Supreme Council of the Black Ajah. She manages to convince Pevara that using the summons to attack and bring down the Black Ajah is a foolish idea. Yukiri and Pevara begin walking so as not to attract attention, and discuss the letters that their Ajahs have received respectively from [[Toveine Gazal]] and [[Akoure Vayet]]{{ref/book|11|p}}.

They also discuss Elaida. Seaine appears and informs them that she has just answered a summons from Elaida; the Amyrlin wished to know how Seaine was doing in her investigation of Alviarin – which means that the Black Ajah hunters’ belief that Elaida could not be Black Ajah is now undermined, because she did not set Seaine on a hunt for the Black Ajah after all {{ref/book|11|p}}.

Pevara asks Yukiri to teach her the weave for bonding, though Pevara doesn’t think Yukiri suspects why she asked{{ref/book|11|e}}.

She is in the White Tower basement when Meidani brings in [[Egwene al'Vere]]. Egwene tells them to continue finding the Black Ajah but remove the fourth oath they have placed on the [[Rebel Spies|rebel spies]]. Egwene also points out that [[Siuan Sanche]] was deposed unlawfully due to at least one known Black Ajah member being part of the bare minimum of Sitters required{{ref/book|12|12}}.

=== Egwene punished ===
Yukiri is at dinner with Elaida and most of the other Sitters when Elaida begins to taunt Egwene and demands her to stop telling lies about a [[Seanchan]] invasion on the White Tower. Egwene refuses and enrages Elaida to the point where she uses the [[One Power]] on Egwene, drawing blood and sending her unconscious{{ref/book|12|16}}.

She pledges her support behind Egwene and stands with the rest of the Hall to raise Egwene unanimously as the new [[Amyrlin Seat]]{{ref/book|12|46}}.

=== Supporting the new young Amyrlin ===
[[File:EgweneLeadingSeaineYukiriandSaerin.JPG|thumb|left|400px|Yukiri (middle left) with Seaine Herimon and Saerin Asnobar deferring to the leadership of Egwene al'Vere - Artwork by Jieroque]]
Later she is in attendance when the Hall meet with [[Rand al'Thor]]. At the meeting Rand announces that he is going to break the remaining [[Seven Seals|seals]] on the [[Dark One]]'s prison. She tries to speak but Rand's ''[[ta'veren]]'' nature keeps her quiet.

After the new raising of Egwene to the Amyrlin Seat, Yukiri meets secretely with her, Saerin, and Seaine and discusses who [[Mesaana]] could be posing as in the White Tower and how she could have defeated the Three Oaths. Egwene tasks them with finding the [[Forsaken]].

Yukiri is one of seven Sitters who take part in [[Nynaeve al'Meara]]'s test for the shawl inside the oval ''[[ter'angreal]]''. The testing is unusually severe. She is one of the four Sitters - the others being Saerin, Seaine, and [[Romanda Cassin]] - who think her worthy, thereby allowing her to be raised properly.

She arrives late to a secret meeting called by Hall of the Tower. Yukiri votes for a proposal that would allow only Egwene to deal with the monarchy of the world, which includes Rand as he is King of [[Illian]], while the Hall would take over prosecution of the war and deal with [[Gareth Bryne]]'s army. In that same meeting, Yukiri votes in favor of the new rules and procedures in the Hall, which include temporarily replacing a Sitter when she is absent from the Hall and that no meeting of the Hall can commence without all Sitters and the Amyrlin Seat being present.

=== Attack of the Black ===
Egwene sets up a meeting in ''[[Tel'aran'rhiod]]'', which Yukiri attends, between Aes Sedai, [[Sea Folk]] [[Windfinder]]s, and [[Aiel]] [[Wise One]]s. It is decided at the meeting that Accepted will go and train with the Wise Ones for six months and then they would train with the Sea Folk for a further six months before returning back to the White Tower. They would then make a choice a year later on where they would wish to finish their training. Sea Folk and Wise One apprentices would also go through this training program but to the White Tower and the other channeling faction. It is agreed that for every two Accepted who leave, two Wise One apprentices and two Sea Folk apprentices will be exchanged. The Sea Folk Bargain is also modified so that Aes Sedai sisters no longer have to teach Sea Folk Windfinders anymore and that Sea Folk Aes Sedai can now return back to their homeland and be the channelers who teach the Sea Folk Windfinders. Finally, all ''ter'angreal'' that are already owned by the Aiel or by the Sea Folk cannot be claimed by the White Tower.

The Black Ajah attack after the meeting in ''Tel'aran'riod''. Yukiri is one of the Aes Sedai who participate in the [[Battle in Tel'aran'rhiod]]; however, because of her relative lack of experience there, she is also one of those sent out by Egwene to safety.

===The Last Battle===
After the great meeting with the Dragon Reborn at Merrilor, Yukiri usually stayed in the Command Center of the Aes Sedai Army. She invented a new weave for a portalwhich can open horizontally, which [[Gareth Bryne]] uses to spy on the enemy armies from far above in the sky. When the [[Shara]]n channelers destroyed the Aes Sedai encampment, Yukiri saved [[Siuan Sanche]] and [[Gareth Bryne]] by pushing them with her into the spying portal and creating a cushion of air to cushion their fall.

Later, she and Siuan healed the wounded soldiers with the help of an ''[[angreal]]'' hoping that the Amyrlin Seat was able to put herself somewhere safe.

After the Last Battle, Yukiri is among the four Sitters - the others being [[Lyrelle]], [[Rubinde]] and [[Saerin]] - who persuade [[Cadsuane]] Melaidhrin to become the new Amyrlin Seat{{ref/book|14|e}}.

== Trivia ==
Excluding the [[Atha'an Miere]] and [[Tuatha'an]], Yukiri is one of only two Aes Sedai who is born [[:Category:Unclaimed territories (people)|outside of the main nations or city-states]] of the books. She was born in Gorien Springs, a village south of Arafel on the road from Shol Arbela to Tar Valon. The second Aes Sedai is [[Nisao Dachen]].
